title: ?e= URL parameter scopes the gallery to the specified event key
description: SessionService.initEventKey() reads the ?e= query parameter, stores it in localStorage as lumen_event_key, and all subsequent Supabase queries filter by event_key=eq.{key}. Loading /home?e=test-isolated-event should show a different (likely empty) gallery than the default demo event.
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Multi-tenancy is critical for production — guests at different events must not see each other's photos. Verifies that the ?e= parameter is read, persisted to localStorage, and that the gallery content changes accordingly.

Remove localStorage key 'lumen_event_key' if present

title: Upload retry message 'Reintentando (N/3)' appears on connection failure
description: SupabaseService.uploadPhotoWithRetry() uses withRetry() with RETRY_BACKOFF_DELAYS_MS [1000,2000,4000]. On each failed attempt, the onRetry callback sets retryMessage to 'Conexión débil. Reintentando (N/3)...' which the uploading state template renders in a .retry-toast element.
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Retry feedback prevents guests from thinking the upload is frozen during a poor-connection event. Requires intercepting the first Supabase storage upload request to respond with 500 so the retry path fires. The test validates the UI feedback, not the network logic itself.

steps.description: Set localStorage key 'lumen_consent' to 'true'; set 'hasSeenTutorial' to 'true'; set 'lumen_tour_completed' to 'true'
Intercept the first outbound request to Supabase storage upload endpoint and force a 500 error response
Navigate to /camera with a pre-loaded gallery image file in router state (isFromGallery=true path)
Verify .state-preview is visible with img.polaroid-photo
Click button containing text 'Revelar'
Verify 'Enviando foto' heading is visible (uploading state)
Verify .retry-toast element is visible containing text 'Reintentando (1/3)'

title: After all retries fail, 'Reintentar subida' manual retry button appears
description: When withRetry() exhausts RETRY_MAX_ATTEMPTS (3), uploadPhoto() catches the final error, sets errorMessage, and transitions back to 'preview' state. The template renders a .btn-retry button with text 'Reintentar subida'. Clicking it calls retryUpload() → uploadPhoto().
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. The manual retry button is the last resort for guests on very poor connections. Without it, a failed upload silently traps the user in preview state with no clear recovery path. Requires intercepting all 3 upload attempts to fail.

steps.description: Set localStorage key 'lumen_consent' to 'true'; set 'hasSeenTutorial' to 'true'; set 'lumen_tour_completed' to 'true'
Intercept ALL outbound Supabase storage upload requests and force 500 responses (to exhaust all 3 retry attempts)
Navigate to /camera with a test image in router state
Click 'Revelar' to trigger upload
Wait for all 3 retry attempts to complete (approximately 7 seconds: 1s + 2s + 4s backoff)
Verify .state-preview is visible (reverted from uploading)
Verify error banner containing 'Error al subir la foto tras varios intentos' is visible
Verify button containing text 'Reintentar subida' is visible
Remove the network intercept

Verify 'Enviando foto' heading appears (upload restarted)

title: In-app browser detection shows warning banner for WhatsApp User-Agent
description: AppComponent.ngOnInit checks navigator.userAgent for 'WhatsApp', 'Instagram', 'FBAN', 'FBAV'. When detected, isInAppBrowser=true renders a fixed yellow banner: 'Para usar la cámara y ver las fotos correctamente, abre este enlace en Safari o Chrome (pulsa los 3 puntos arriba a la derecha).'
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Wedding guests often click QR-code links inside WhatsApp or Instagram, which restricts camera APIs. The banner is critical to direct users to a real browser. Test by overriding the User-Agent header to contain 'WhatsApp' in the Playwright browser context.

title: Photo viewer 'Guardar' button triggers blob download and shows 'Guardando...' loading state
description: downloadPhoto() in HomeComponent calls supabaseService.downloadImageAsBlob(photo.publicUrl, filename) which fetch()-es the image as a Blob and triggers a browser download via <a download>. isDownloading signal is true during the fetch, showing 'Guardando...' inside the button.
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Photo download is explicitly mentioned as a key user feature. The Blob mechanism is used (not a direct link) to force-save on mobile, where cross-origin anchor downloads open in a new tab instead. Test validates the loading state and that a download is initiated.

title: Admin wrong PIN shows 'Invalid PIN. Please try again.' error
description: authenticate() compares pinInput() to the hardcoded '2102'. A wrong 4-digit PIN sets authError to 'Invalid PIN. Please try again.' The .auth-error paragraph renders this message and the dashboard does not appear.
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Without this test there is no verification that brute-force is surfaced with an error rather than silently ignored. Tests the failed authentication branch of the admin PIN flow.

title: Camera shutter button transitions from viewfinder to preview state
description: With camera permission granted, startCamera() streams video to the <video> element. Clicking the shutter button (data-tour='shutter') calls capturePhoto() which draws the video frame to a canvas, converts it to a Blob, and transitions currentState to 'preview'. The .state-preview shows the polaroid card.
coverage_note: Zero coverage before. Capturing a photo is the core camera feature. Requires browser camera permission to be ALLOWED. Verifies the entire viewfinder→capture→preview state machine transition.
